meta.title: Auction Time Controls: not available on plans below Growth
gaps: Identify a tenant on a plan below Growth and a tenant on Growth when no tenant IDs are provided, then repeat the same actions across both tenants
Verify that the capability is unavailable specifically because the tenant is below Growth
Shorten submission time; the catalog supports extending submission time but not decreasing submission time
Log a reason for every submission-time control action
